name: Spadel S.a.
summary: Société de Services, de Participations, de Direction et d'Elaboration produces and markets natural mineral water in Belgium. It offers natural mineral water under the Spa, Bru, Wattwiller, Carola, Brecon Carreg, and Devin brand names. The company is based in Woluwé-Saint-Lambert, Belgium. Société de Services, de Participations, de Direction et d'Elaboration is a subsidiary of Finances Et Industries SA.
